description: This PHP source file defines the EmployeeSupervisorAPI class, which implements CRUD operations for managing employee supervisor relationships in the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It includes methods for retrieving, listing, creating, updating, and deleting supervisor records, along with validation rules and API documentation annotations.

classes.name: EmployeeSupervisorAPI
classes.description: API class providing CRUD operations and related functionalities for managing employee supervisor relationships within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getEmployeeReportingMethodService
methods.description: Returns an instance of EmployeeReportingMethodService, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: getReportingMethodConfigurationService
methods.description: Returns an instance of ReportingMethodConfigurationService, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a specific supervisor record for an employee based on employee number and supervisor ID.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the getOne method, ensuring employee number and supervisor ID are accessible.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Lists all supervisors for a specific employee with pagination and sorting support.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the getAll method, including employee number validation and sorting parameters.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Adds a new supervisor record for an employee.

methods.name: setSupervisorParams
methods.description: Populates a ReportTo entity with parameters from the request payload.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for creating a new supervisor record.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes one or more supervisor records for an employee.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Provides validation rules for deleting supervisor records.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing supervisor record for an employee.

methods.name: getUrlAttributes
methods.description: Retrieves URL parameters (employee number and supervisor ID) from the request.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for updating supervisor records.

methods.name: getEmpNumberRule
methods.description: Validation rule ensuring the employee number is accessible and valid.

methods.name: getReportingMethodIdRule
methods.description: Validation rule for the reporting method ID parameter.

methods.name: getSupervisorIdsRule
methods.description: Validation rule for an array of supervisor IDs.
